title: Zero-gravity bonding of ceramic to metal with human DNA, used in medical implants

tellings.quote: And then they figured out in zero gravity how to to bond ceramic to metal. And then they were able to put human DNA into the ceramic.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, speaking on a podcast, says he was told that researchers working in space, in zero gravity, worked out how to bond ceramic to metal. According to Bledsoe, they were then able to put human DNA into the ceramic, and this was used to make medical implants. If true, it would be a striking advance that came out of work in space.
